probabilities_note: SUBJECTIVE (Claude's judgement, not engine odds): bear 30% = seat compression / federal / post-acquisition indigestion makes the 2027-2029 deceleration steep; base 50% = the cRPO path (18.5% exit) fades ~1.5 pts a year; bull 20% = AI consumption re-accelerates growth in 2027-2028 as management claims.

notes.basis: All per-share figures POST 5-for-1 split (17.12.2025). Price $108.35 IBKR 04.11.2026 18:55 UTC. Q3'26 release and 10-Q are post-split; Q2'25/Q3'25 releases are pre-split (EPS /5).
notes.rev0_m: FY2026 total revenue = 9M actual 11,863 (Q1 3,770 + Q2 3,987 + Q3 4,106; releases/10-Q) + Q4 guide: subscription 4,245-4,255 (R3 lines 140-192, midpoint 4,250) + professional services ~125 (Q3 was 118) = ~4,375 -> 16,238; AV consensus FY26 revenue 16,234 (39 analysts). Used 16,240.
notes.shares_m: 1,050M = Q4'26 guided diluted weighted shares (R3). Treatment of SBC: counted ONCE as a cash-equivalent cost (FCF after SBC = company FCF - gross SBC) and the share count is held flat, i.e. the ~1.4%/yr issuance (10.8M shares in 9M'26) is assumed offset by buybacks funded from that charge. Buybacks beyond that ($4.2B authorization) are NOT counted (upside not in the value). RSUs 41.8M + options 6.9M outstanding (4.7% of shares) are the stock of that future cost.
notes.net_cash_m: End-2026 estimate: cash+securities 6,961 (9/30/26, R3) + implied Q4 FCF 2,725 (FY guide 36% x 16,240 = 5,846 minus 9M 3,121) - Q4 net-share-settlement tax ~150 - pending Sweep deal ~400 (low confidence) = 9,136; + strategic investments 2,050 at a 50% haircut = 1,025; - debt principal 7,600 (senior notes 5,500 + commercial paper 2,100) - operating leases 891 (debt-like) = 1,670. No Q4 buyback assumed (GAP: none in Q2/Q3; authorization $4.2B). Sensitivity: each $1B = ~$0.95/share.
notes.rf_erp_beta: rf 4.94% (10y), ERP 4.2%, beta 1.44 (2-year weekly vs SPY, given by the main loop), mature beta 1.1 -> ke 10.99% fading to 9.56%. Index return rf+ERP = 9.1%.
notes.tax: 20%: Q3 provision $93M on ~$370M pretax (~25%) includes discrete items; FY26 had a $51M California valuation-allowance release; 20% long-run with R&D credits/FDII. Cash taxes are lower today (GAP); not modelled.
notes.g_base: 2027 18%: Q4 cRPO guide 18.5% (reported and cc) with ~75bp of explained noise (25bp early renewals pulled into Q3, ~50bp T4C provisions excluded from cRPO but in revenue; call, Mastantuono) minus 1-2 pts of inorganic contribution that anniversaries in Mar/Apr 2027 (Veza, Armis; acquired share 'not material' per 10-Q, so inference) and FX. AV consensus FY27 revenue 19,268 = +18.7% (46 analysts, cut from ~19.3B 7 days ago). Later years fade ~1.5 pts/yr (NOW's 2022-2025 organic path 23 -> 24 -> 22 -> 21; the law of large numbers at $20B+), 2032 11%.
notes.g_bear: 2027 12%: seat compression (50% of net new business already non-seat, per management; seat-based renewals shrink as agents replace tickets/agents), federal budget cuts (one federal channel partner = 20% of receivables; federal signings concentrated in Q3), no AI consumption inflection; organic falls to mid single digits by 2029 as the acquisitions anniversary. Charges: restructuring cash $500M after tax in 2027 and $400M in 2028 (2026 severance already $167M in 9M; a bigger AI-driven programme). Goodwill/intangible write-downs ($10.0B goodwill, $3.6B intangibles after Armis/Veza/Moveworks) are non-cash and are expressed through the lower growth and margin, not as a cash charge.
notes.g_bull: 2027 20%: management's claim that the 'true acceleration' from AI consumption arrives in 2027 (13x agentic consumption YTD, AI net new ACV +65% y/y in Q3, target $1.7B+), Moveworks $100M ACV in 3 quarters, Armis/Veza cross-sell. Capped at 20% (not 22%+) because the beat record has shrunk from ~1% to ~0.3% on subscription revenue and Q4 cRPO guided down to 18.5%.
notes.m: Operating margin AFTER SBC and after amortization of purchased intangibles (GAAP-like, excluding only business-combination costs and severance in later years). 2026 reference: non-GAAP 31.5% - SBC 15% - amortization 4% - severance 1% - deal costs 1% = GAAP ~10%. Base path: non-GAAP margin 32.5% (2027) -> 35% (2032); SBC 14.5% -> 11% (SBC was ~20% of revenue in 2021, 14.4% Q3'25, 15.3% Q3'26 with acquisition grants; unrecognized RSU cost $4.2B over ~3 yrs); amortization 3.5% -> ~1% (acquired tech ~6 yr life, customer relationships ~5 yr, so the 2026 intangibles are mostly amortized by 2031-32); severance/deal 1% -> 0.5%. => 13.5, 15.5, 17.5, 19.5, 21, 22.5%. Bear: 11-15% (price pressure, non-GAAP margin stuck ~30%, SBC stays 14-15%). Bull: 14.5 -> 26% (non-GAAP 37%, SBC 10%).
notes.conv: FCF/NOPAT where FCF = company FCF (OCF - capex) - gross SBC. Company FCF margin 36% guided for 2026 (capex 3% of revenue, D&A 9% incl. amortization, deferred-revenue growth ~4-5 pts at 20% growth, low cash taxes). 2027: 32.5 (non-GAAP op) + 2.5 (D&A ex-amortization 5.5 - capex 3) + 4.5 (working capital) - 4 (cash taxes) - 14.5 (SBC) = 21% of revenue; later 21.5, 22, 22, 22, 22% as the working-capital tailwind fades with growth and the hosting commitments ($432M FY27 -> $2.8B FY30) raise the cost base while margin expands. conv = fcf margin / (m x 0.8): 1.94, 1.73, 1.57, 1.41, 1.31, 1.22. conv > 1 is correct here because SBC and amortization are non-cash and are already charged in m; SBC is subtracted once (in m and in the FCF numerator the same gross amount), shares flat. Interest on net cash is added by the model separately.
notes.pe: Exit P/E on 2032 operating EPS after SBC (end-2031). Base 24x: justified value for ~10% growth fading to rf with ROIC 30% at a mature ke of 9.56% is (1 - g/ROIC)/(ke - g) = (1 - 0.07/0.30)/(0.0956 - 0.07) = 30x at g 7%, 22x at g 6%; 24x sits below the midpoint. Bear 17x (ex-growth software, Oracle 2014-19 traded 14-17x). Bull 30x.
notes.roic_terminal: 30%: 2032 base NOPAT ~6.5B on invested capital ~16B (goodwill 10B + intangibles + PP&E - deferred revenue); software ROIC ex-goodwill is far higher, 30% is conservative.
notes.horizon: days_to_base_year_end 57 (04.11.2026 -> 31.12.2026); years_to_horizon 5.16 (to end-2031); buy_return 13% = owner's required return for the 'add' price.

review_changes: reviewer 04.11: margin expansion trimmed (subscription gross margin 80%->74% on third-party cloud; cloud commitments step to $2.8B in FY30): non-GAAP ~33.5% by 2032; exit P/E 24->21 (consistent with the DCF leg at ROIC 30%); bear year 1 +15% (largely contracted: 46% of RPO in 12 months, 98% renewal), bear P/E 20, SBC cut; operating leases out of net debt; M&A cash $500M/yr after tax charged; tax 21% (non-GAAP long-term rate); FCF after SBC ~20-21% net of severance/deal costs; 2027 growth 17.5% (consensus 18.7%, inorganic anniversaries). buy_return = ke0 (the owner sets no required return).
